name: What common safety upgrades are recommended for older homes in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What common safety upgrades are recommended for older homes in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For older homes in the Bay Area, common safety upgrades often include seismic retrofitting to protect against earthquakes, electrical system updates to modern code, and plumbing replacements to prevent leaks and improve water quality. Enhancing fire safety through smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, sprinkler systems, and fire-rated doors is also crucial. Additionally, improving indoor air quality with proper ventilation systems and addressing lead paint or asbestos concerns are important considerations for occupant health.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common safety upgrades for older Bay Area homes include seismic retrofitting, electrical and plumbing updates, and fire safety enhancements.
